messages:
Sam K: morning async — quick standup
Sam K: yesterday: scaled us-east-2 nodepool +20 GPUs (p4d->p4), rotated NVIDIA drivers on 3 hosts, ran canary perf test — latency within target.
Sam K: blocker: eu-west-1 spot eviction cascade — 2 workers repeatedly flapping, autoscaler drains them but they keep rejoining in CrashLoop. suspect kernel/module mismatch.
Sam K: today: open ticket with cloud quota team, try warm-standby with g4dn in eu-west-1 for critical shards, coordinate with @Jin H.
Maria G: saw the flaps — can you paste the kubelet logs? any recent kernel updates on those hosts? :thinking:
Sam K: pasted logs: ```kubelet ERROR: failed to start kubelet: nv_peer_mem init failed, kernel module oops``` (snip) link: https://internal-logs/rw/eu-west/2023/abcd
Leo W: if it's a kernel/driver mismatch, short-term fallback = route traffic to us-east-2 and scale there. I'll change routing policy for the next hour to shift capacity.
Taylor R: I'll run a capacity sim for the routing shift, will post numbers in ~10m.
Ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1: 2x P4d instances flapping — 2023-09-12T09:12Z (autodetected by fleet-monitor)
Jin H: I can file a quota increase + support escalation. ping me the project id and exact quota numbers you want.
Sam K: project: rw-infer-prod-eu. Need +8 P4d GPUs and +16 G4dn as warm fallback. Also want ephemeral spot limit increase for prewarm jobs. Thanks @Jin H
Taylor R: sim results: shifting 25% traffic -> us-east-2 keeps p95 within SLO. Quick summary: `{"qps":1200,"p95_ms":220,"cost_delta":"+12%"}` — will attach raw CSV to the ticket.
Maria G: ack. Sam: want me to open a rollback canary for the driver change and re-deploy without the kernel update?
Sam K: yes please — roll back driver to 510.xx on the 3 nodes and hold further kernel patches until we confirm. Coordinate window with Leo for routing.
Anya P: FYI I'll update fleet-sizes.md and the runbook to document warm-standby policy + fallback regions.
Leo W: routing updated at 09:30 UTC to shift traffic, monitoring autoscaler and queue backlog. :thumbsup:
Sam K: thanks all. Jin, ping when you have the support ticket link and I'll pop it in the incident channel. end.
